Name: Hemdan
Summary: Hemdan was a son of Dishon, the son of Anah, and a descendant of Seir the Horite.
KeyStory: Hemdan is named first among Dishon's four children.
RelatedPeople: Dishon, Son of Anah; Eshban; Ithran; Cheran
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
